remarks: Move right into this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1-bath co-op in sought-after Putnam Park. Enjoy the best of Greenwich living nestled in a serene, park-like setting, yet minutes from Greenwich Avenue, Whole Foods, Metro-North, shops, restaurants and more. This sun-filled second-floor corner unit features a spacious open layout, refinished hardwood floors, plenty of closet space, and the convenience of in-unit laundry. The primary bedroom is generously sized, while the second bedroom offers flexibility as a home office or den. A private balcony provides a peaceful outdoor retreat. Monthly maintenance includes heat, hot water, trash and snow removal, and landscaping. Additional shared storage space is available for residents. District tax $827.79 semi-annually (paid in December and July)
